text:
micah: Heads-up — we need to finalize the header precedence rules for gateway routing before the rollout tomorrow morning. Current ambiguity around `X-Cust-*` vs `Authorization` vs UA-derived routing is causing surprises in staging.
anya: Agree. Saw a tenant hit the wrong pool because UA sniffing kicked in after a custom header was added by a partner integration.
darren: Can we be explicit in two parts: 1) matching precedence (exact header overrides heuristics), 2) what we propagate to origin (strip, forward, or sign)?
samir: I like explicit rules. Proposal from infra: precedence order = explicit route match (path/host) -> signed header (x-route-sign) -> customer-provided header (x-cust-*) -> inferred UA claim -> auth-derived claims (from JWT). That keeps intentional routing first.
micah: Hmm. Putting auth-derived claims last feels odd — many customers rely on tenant info in JWT to route to dedicated capacity.
anya: Right. We have two different use-cases: internal SRE routing (trust JWT) vs external partner integrations (custom header). Maybe we need a policy scope: "trusted" vs "untrusted" headers. If header origin is from edge-auth (we verified signing) it's trusted.
darren: So split rules by trust vector. If header has `X-Route-Signature` and `X-Route-Signer` matches key in vault -> treat as signed and high precedence. If header originates from upstream partner network (no sign) -> lower precedence.
samir: Implementation detail: edge will add `x-edge-signature` for any header we sign at the edge. Downstream services can check `x-edge-signer` and `x-edge-time`.
anya: For UA-derived routing we need a fallback only. UA heuristics are brittle and cause wrong shard assignment when clients embed SDK changes. Keep UA last unless explicitly opted-in per route.
micah: Quotas question: if route selection changes mid-request (e.g., fallback after capacity error), which quota bucket do we attribute? The original route or the fallback route?
darren: We should attribute to the final executed route to be conservative for capacity billing, but record an event linking original route attempt for telemetry.
anya: Telemetry: we need a header-level decision log in traces: `x-route-decisions: signed_header -> route:dedicated-A -> fallback:shared-B (if happened)`. This should be sampled but present for 100% of canaries.
micah: UX for rollouts: console should show active routing policy per route with precedence ordering and a toggle for "trust signed headers". Also show recent mismatches (when inbound header would have routed but signature missing).
samir: Security: default deny for any header-based claim that tries to escalate tenant privileges. If `x-cust-tenant-id` present but not validated against auth token we route to an unprivileged shard and flag as suspicious.
darren: Config snippet idea to put in repo:

```
route:
  match: /v1/chat
  precedence:
    - path_host
    - signed_header: { header: "x-route-signer", key_id: "edge-routing" }
    - header: { header: "x-cust-tenant-id", trust: "scoped" }
    - ua_infer: { enabled: false }
    - jwt_claim: { claim: "tenant_id" }
  fallback_on_capacity: true
  attribute_quota_to: executed_route
```

anya: Looks good. One more: we must prevent header spoofing from clients. Edge must remove inbound `x-edge-signature` present from internet unless it was generated by our edge. Basically canonicalize signatures at the first hop.
micah: Good call. Also provide a diagnostic endpoint that given headers shows which rule would match and why (for debugging by SEs).
samir: I'll sketch the implementation: edge validator plugin verifies signatures, sets internal header `x-edge-trust-level` = signed|verified|untrusted, then router uses that. Also emit span attributes `header.match` and `header.trust`.
anya: Tests: add unit tests for precedence permutations + integration test where a partner sends unsigned `x-cust-*` and then signed variant.
darren: Can someone draft the RFC? I can start a doc with the config snippet and threat model.
micah: I'll put the draft in RFCs/ and ping security and console for UX mockups. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: ensure edge key rotation scheduled -> OK (rotating-key-2026-03-20)
anya: tagging follow-up: @security @console please review the UX and threat model by EOD so we don't stall rollout.
micah: @anya @darren let's sync 30m before deployment to walk the checklist.
